claims: Monitor INR (PT) and PT levels closely.
Assess and manage fluid balance carefully.
Continue mechanical ventilation with close monitoring of respiratory parameters.
Evaluate and manage electrolyte imbalances, particularly potassium and sodium.
Administer fluids as needed to maintain blood pressure and volume status.
Monitor for signs of infection and consider broad-spectrum antibiotics if indicated.
Assess and manage coagulopathy, considering vitamin K or fresh frozen plasma if INR is significantly elevated.
Monitor blood glucose levels and adjust insulin if necessary to prevent hyperglycemia.
Continue aggressive management of acid-base status, including respiratory support if necessary.
Assess for and manage anemia, considering blood transfusions if hemoglobin or hematocrit levels are critically low.
